meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 把原本通用的网页输出改成有明确视觉风格的前端实现:先定下大胆的美学方向,再产出可运行的 HTML/CSS/JS、React 或 Vue 代码,并在字体、配色、动效、布局和背景细节上做差异化处理,避免千篇一律的AI样式。
howto.when: 当你要求构建网页组件、页面或应用等前端界面时触发;也可能在你提供具体界面需求时介入。

say.text: 帮我设计一个复古未来风格的落地页
say.note: Claude 会先定风格方向再产出页面代码

say.text: 用 React 做一个带交互动效的仪表盘
say.note: 会使用 Motion 等库实现动效

say.text: 给我一个极简的登录表单组件

howto.what_en: Changes the default output into a distinctive frontend implementation: it commits to a bold aesthetic direction, then produces runnable HTML/CSS/JS, React, or Vue code with differentiated typography, color, motion, layout, and background details, avoiding generic AI looks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications; also when they describe a specific interface to build.

say_en.text: Design a retro-futuristic landing page for me
say_en.note: Claude sets the style direction first, then codes the page.

say_en.text: Build a dashboard with interactive motion in React
say_en.note: Uses Motion and other animation techniques.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist login form component
say_en.note: Focuses on spacing, typography, and color.
